It now has `pub use athena_core::introspect::{...}`. The full record type IntrospectionRecord / INTROSPECTION_SCHEMA is in athena-data records.rs. The backtest view `Introspection` is defined once in introspect.rs and built via `Introspection::code_fields`.

criteria.criterion: A class registry record store exists. New classes are added as `proposed` with a code-assigned id, and the repository files are never edited.
criteria.evidence: introspect.rs apply_answer builds FailureClass { id: RecordId::generate(..), status: ClassStatus::Proposed } and commits it as a record. store.rs loads `classes`, and read_records reads records/failure-classes. The test a_rejected_job_... asserts that only records/ paths changed and that athena.toml is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: The §3.3 reading code reads only the listed stored fields (never transcripts, diffs or other jobs' files). It narrows by class_of_work and category, caps earlier cases at 5, and passes only those fields to the model.
criteria.evidence: narrow_cases filters on class_of_work and category, newest first, and truncates to CASE_CAP=5. CaseRow holds only id, job, at, class_of_work, category, first line of what, failure_class and cause. user_prompt sends only the event fields, the class rows and the cases. A test asserts the exact prompt key sets, and the narrowing/cap test passes.

criteria.criterion: On return, any earlier_cases or decisions_matched id not on the list passed in is dropped and logged. A cause equal to what_happened after normalising is flagged and the record rated failed.
criteria.evidence: apply_answer (introspect.rs ~1145-1179) drops ids not passed in (or not in the class) into dropped_ids, with a ui.line for each. normalise() comparison sets a flag and a failure, and status stays Failed. Tests an_earlier_case_..._dropped and a_cause_that_restates_... cover both.

criteria.criterion: Introspection is triggered automatically for a rejected job, a failed job, a correction and any other intervention. It is not triggered for a failed introspection.
criteria.evidence: run.rs go() wraps go_job and calls introspect_job on Rejected or Failed. manage.rs intervene and reading.rs correction call introspect_intervention. An introspection is not an intervention or outcome, so it triggers nothing. The test asserts the model was called exactly once after a failed introspection.

findings.summary: Earlier cases are narrowed before the class is chosen, so cases from other classes reach the model and are then dropped
findings.evidence: apply_answer drops an earlier case that was passed in but lies outside the chosen class, and logs it alongside ids that were never passed in. That log line merges two different reasons.

summary: The change builds step 1 of the introspection work. A rejected or failed `go`, a correction or answer, and any other intervention each trigger one athena.introspection/1 record automatically. The model is reached through the existing agent driver, and no Jev is called. A class registry (athena.failure-class/1 records) adds new classes as `proposed` with an id assigned by code. The §3.3 reading code narrows earlier cases by class of work and category, caps them at 5, and sends only the listed fields. Returned ids that were not passed in are dropped and logged. A cause that restates what happened is flagged and the record is rated failed. A failed introspection is recorded as failed, never blocks the job, and is not itself introspected. `athena status <job>` shows the record in text and in --json. The records reader, typed headers, evidence-after-decision rule and citation validation moved from backtest.rs into athena_core::introspect, which backtest re-exports. Backtest lost no tests and gained one. I ran `cargo test --locked` (all pass, including the 10 new fixture tests), clippy with -D warnings and `cargo fmt --check`: all clean. The only issue is minor: three files outside the deliverables list were changed (manage.rs, reading.rs, store.rs). Each is a small, needed hook for the correction and intervention triggers or for loading the new record kinds.
